description: JUNCO: the owner's policy.json in front of PayPal's own plugin (MCP server paypal-sandbox) or any MCP server named paypal. Reads and allowed writes pass to Claude Code's own permission flow; refunds, dispute accepts and anything else the policy holds are stored for the owner and never reach PayPal from the editor until the owner, at their terminal, runs `junco-gate approve <id>`. The plain routes around the gate (running the approve command, changing policy.json or .junco/) are refused.
